title: Stateful Python execution

# Stateful Python execution

The cells on this page share one page-scoped Python session.

```{python}
#| label: python-setup
#| echo: true
values = [2, 4, 6]
total = sum(values)
```

```{python}
#| label: python-streams
import sys

print(f"Python total: {total}")
print("Intentional Python stderr", file=sys.stderr)
```

```{python}
#| label: python-markdown
from IPython.display import Markdown

Markdown(f"**Python total:** `{total}`")
```

```{python}
#| label: python-figure
#| fig-alt: A bar labeled with the Python total
from IPython.display import SVG

SVG(
    f"""<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="160" height="80"
    viewBox="0 0 160 80" role="img">
    <rect x="10" y="10" width="{total * 10}" height="40" fill="#3366cc" />
    <text x="10" y="70">total = {total}</text>
    </svg>"""
)
```

```{python}
#| label: python-error
#| error: true
raise RuntimeError("intentional Python fixture error")
```
